issue: Restorative stretch/rest pose, not a strength exercise; muscles listed are those being lengthened/relaxed (erector spinae, lats, glutes, posterior delts) rather than active prime movers. Categorized as Bodyweight/timed.

Gluteus medius is the prime mover but has no dedicated bucket; encoded under 'glutes' as Gluteus Medius (its allowed latin), gluteus maximus as secondary. Tensor fasciae latae (a noted synergist) has no allowed value and was omitted.
